features.name: Agent Reasoning Display
features.description: A feature that surfaces the payables agent's reasoning to users through an info icon, allowing them to see why the agent suggested a specific field value such as GL account or deferral code.
caveats: Will potentially expand to other features

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: An AI agent that assists with payables processing by suggesting field values such as GL accounts and deferral codes in purchase documents.
